form.label: Save to GitHub
form.description: Commit the current lab configuration (including dashboards created in this session) to the lab-snapshot branch on GitHub.

input.label: Save current lab changes to GitHub?
input.choice: Yes — commit & push to the lab-snapshot branch

search.query: | makeresults count=1 | eval trigger="$confirm$" | labsync | rename status as Status, message as Message, commit as Commit, branch as Branch | table Status Message Commit Branch

ul.li: Create or edit dashboards, etc. in the Lab Overview app as usual - Splunk saves them into the app.
Come here, choose Yes, and click Submit.
The current app state is committed and pushed to the lab-snapshot branch on GitHub.
Review it there and merge into main when you are happy - the next session will include it.

html.p: Admin-only. Requires a GitHub token to be configured on the box (see the repo README, "Save to GitHub" section). If you see a "no token" error, the token was not provided at session start.
